result.summary: The home screen of a food delivery app is mostly clean and well laid out. One notable defect: the '15–25 min' delivery time pill on the first 'Fastest near you' card overlaps and sits over the plate image, and it looks misaligned compared with the other cards. Minor contrast and consistency concerns are noted below.

issues.description: On the first 'Fastest near you' card (Green Bowl Poké), the '15–25 min' pill overlaps the edge of the plate illustration. Its position looks inconsistent with the pills on the other cards, which sit cleanly over the bottom-left of the image.
issues.suggestion: Anchor the time pills with the same fixed offsets on every card, and make sure the image is scaled or positioned so the pill does not cover key parts of the food image.

issues.description: The secondary gray text (delivery fees, '(500+)', the search placeholder and inactive tab labels) is light gray on a white or light-gray background, so contrast is low.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text colors to meet the WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

issues.description: The Green Bowl Poké card image has a pale, washed-out background that blends into the page, so the card has no clear edge. The other cards have dark backgrounds, so the row looks inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle border or shadow, or normalize the image backgrounds, so the card boundaries are consistent.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) icon on the '-20%' pizza card sits on a semi-transparent dark circle over a busy image, and it is not aligned with the heart on the ramen card above. The ramen heart's circle is barely visible.
issues.suggestion: Give the favorite buttons a consistent size, position and background so they are equally visible.
